amendments.done_when: For new and existing client repos, the shipped guide says a fast test in pull request CI must include the tests that import changed source files, split across the test groups, that a local fast test may stay smaller, that the full suite stays nightly, and it warns against a changed-files-only script.

done_when: For new and existing client repos, the shipped guide says a fast test in pull request CI must include the tests that import changed source files, split across the test groups, that a local fast test may stay smaller, that the full suite stays nightly, and it warns against a changed-files-only script. The guide also says that Forge's Python picker does not yet follow imports in an app that lives in a sub-folder; the repair of the picker is the separate fix review-findings-split-from-a-repo-s-own.

known.title: Functional: The Python picker misses direct imports in nested apps

stop.reason: The owner chose: split; the picker is repaired in a separate Forge fix, and this guide fix goes on with one honest sentence about the limit

why: A repo's own fast test ran only the changed test files plus a few fixed files in pull request CI, so unchanged tests that import a changed source file were skipped, failed on the main branch, and blocked every other close.
